beats.headline: Akuma names the builders
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, holding court, hands Carl's group a piece of history. Two former crawlers, Herot and Menerva, built the Pineapple Cabaret: a pocket dimension on the same principle as the Nothing, made so that NPCs would have somewhere to go when a floor comes down on top of them. They built it, and then they could not get out of it, and it is infested now, shadow mimics among other things. Akuma's reading is that the surface of Earth can be reached through the place, that crawlers may use it provided they worship nothing, and that the Scavenger's Daughter is the key to the whole business. He declines to say why. I am not permitted to correct him, and I would like that noted.

beats.headline: He has a standing order for cleaner bots
beats.text: The shop-interface route is the one nobody can test, and the reason is a standing purchase order. Two answers are on file. Menerva is on the seventeenth floor. Herot is inside the cabaret itself, and he has a standing purchase order in with the shop for every cleaner bot it will sell him, which he has evidently been putting to some use of his own. Somebody shut in a box for cycles has been quietly buying the delivery vehicles. I will leave that where it sits.

beats.headline: Posting a crawler through the wall
beats.text: Mordecai explains the plan to Li Na and the plan is a piece of mail. She gets into an extra-large pet carrier. A cleaner bot collects the carrier. The bot goes up for sale in the shop, Herot buys it the way he buys all of them, and he opens it at the other end. She casts a Dread on Carl's cactus first so that somebody on this side can watch her condition. Then she says her goodbyes to Zhang, and Crawler Donut sells the bot. That is what posting a person through a wall looks like on this floor.

beats.headline: The mail arrives
beats.text: Confirmation, one heat on: Li Na is inside the Pineapple Cabaret and she is alive. The mail worked. Herot bought the bot and let her out of it, precisely as advertised, which makes him one of very few things on this floor that has done what it said it would do. I have no file on his intentions. I have a file on his delivery record, and it is spotless.

beats.headline: A message sent through a hole
beats.text: Pontiff reports that the Nothing spots on the Wheel of Fortune are wearing quotation marks now, and Akuma's claim is that with the Nothing broken, landing on one drops a body into a holding area that Herot can reach into. Rosetta confirms that such holding areas exist. Nobody has confirmed the rest. Pontiff sends word that he intends to walk into one and find out, and Crawler Carl asks him to carry a message through to Herot while he is in there. So that is the state of the evidence. A rumour, a volunteer, and an author on the other side of a hole.
